verdict.rationale: Shopify POS documents developer-facing UI extensions and CLI scaffolding, but the evidence pack contains nothing about a simulated card reader, test card numbers, a payments test mode, or an end-to-end sandbox for in-person payments. Extension scaffolding is a developer building block, not a test environment, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can test my in-person integration end-to-end with a simulated reader or test card environment before going live
